title: dlt Failures by Pipeline
app: dlt (data load tool) pipeline trace and load-info events forwarded as JSON to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=dlt:load status="failed"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by pipeline_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts dlt failures grouped by pipeline so operators immediately see which specific pipelines are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'dlt is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest dlt failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical pipelines.
visualization: Table of pipeline by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of dlt are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
